Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.

Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.

489-586-728-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1011-2728-5147-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5147-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5147-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

250-779-1479-5413-7893.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-7893.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5413-7893.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

955-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2506-6753-7150-7752.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2060-3525-3574-7741.notablePrerequisites: Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
2060-3525-3574-7741.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3525-3574-7741.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

1362-1993-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1362-1993-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.

2060-2577-2921-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2577-2921-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

372-1734-2781.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1734-2781.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian exiled by Fiend Hunter
372-1734-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Fiend Hunter to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Fiend Hunter and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1-4067-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, targeting Sensei's Divining Top.
Containment Construct triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sensei's Divining Top.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Sensei's Divining Top ability from step 1, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Sensei's Divining Top, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top from your graveyard with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping the targeted permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
